Risk_Description: A user may include personal information in a public review.
Mitigation_Action: Add privacy notice; prohibit personal data; validate and moderate content; hide account email.

Risk_Description: Unverified or harmful reviews could unfairly damage people or places.
Mitigation_Action: Publish only approved content; apply moderation rules; provide reporting and disclaimer.

Risk_Description: Third-party images, icons, text, or guide content may lack permission or attribution.
Mitigation_Action: Use original or licensed assets; record attribution; remove disputed content.

Risk_Description: The admin dashboard is directly reachable and demo credentials/localStorage are not secure authentication.
Mitigation_Action: Protect the route; use server-side authentication and authorization; secure sessions; sanitize input; log actions.

Risk_Description: Real personal data could be collected or published without sufficient notice, consent, retention, or removal controls.
Mitigation_Action: Use fictional/masked data; provide notice and consent; minimize data; define retention/deletion; review before deployment.

Risk_Description: Outdated, incomplete, duplicated, or misleading reviews could reduce trust and cause poor decisions.
Mitigation_Action: Validate fields; use unique IDs and statuses; moderate; archive outdated reviews; support correction/reporting.
